notes.title: Update to Version 1.02
notes.content:
- Minor bug fixed
- You can now press "ESC" and disable double tap to Dodge Roll
- You can now press "V" to Dodge Roll (You can change the button via Input tab when you launch the game)
- You can setting the Skill Button via Input tab when you launch the game
- Increase Cooldown for Rogue's Arrow storm and Knight's Earthen Fury
